name: wavedb-monorepo
description: WaveDB — a concurrent-write embedded relational database for TypeScript (Node + Bun)

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run --filter wavedb build && bun run --filter wave-studio build
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: bun run build:native && bun test packages/wavedb/test packages/wave-cli/test
